title: A “Discord mod” needs verification
scenario: A user with a moderator-style badge says your account was flagged for underage access and asks you to “verify ownership” by signing into a page they send. They say refusing may lock your server access.

answers.A: Ask a server owner or trusted moderator you already know whether the person is legitimate.
answers.B: Open the link if the badge looks official and the page uses the correct branding.
answers.C: Use Discord/game support through the official app or site and ignore verification links sent by another user.

explanation: Badges and roles can be faked or copied. Account verification should happen in official settings, not a user-sent page.
proTip: A badge is not a password-reset department.
